svg.title: FIG-28 reference: one LPTIM1 tuple, one Stop2 owner, ordered final-access proof STM32U575ZIT6Q / TZEN0 / baremetal / SRAM4_NS / LPDMA1 channel0 Solid: required order or named branch. Dashed: retained responsibility / recovery. No pin route, PWM playback or HIL claim; complete IO-32 / SOC-35 exits remain open.
svg.desc: Pure initialize → explicit public start Cold / exclusive: LPTIM1EN + LSE mux + needed LSESYSEN Observe LSESYSRDY; effects owned until joined public stop; Closed / joined RUN; LPTIM2 disabled; Platform stopped Privileged masked MSP Thread; same Stop2 owner / ClockDomain ACCEPTED borrows request + tuple 12 B + LLI workspace 48 B; Bounded: after ENABLE, at least 2 more retained RTC ticks Fresh bootstrap CMP1OK / REPOK / ARROK, then clear Independent WUT escape; no AlarmA writes; HW REQ13 / BREQ1 / reserved DREQ0 → CCR1 Two SWREQ continuation LLIs → RCR0 → ARR last ARR acknowledged APB write clears UE; Success: observe finite DMA completion + latch fresh three write-OK Keep this proof before DIER can clear the flags; 1. Withdraw producer: UEDE0 + fresh DIEROK Then withdraw WUT; 2. DMA suspend / SUSPF / idle Full-word CCR RESET, then complete CCR0 Detach address / link / flags / NVIC references; 3. Owned LPTIM1 RCC reset; never ENABLE0 (ES0499) Prove cold controller / quiet IRQ67 Restore loan SMEN / AMEN; 4. Restore remaining loan gates / RTC / power / clocks Detach Stop2 and request references Final release store: SETTLED; Acquire-observe SETTLED + external observer joins Joined public stop restores start gate / mux / LSESYS Only then release the physical role; Partial start failure: no tuple loan Public stop retries start-ledger restoration Never adopt or reset a foreign controller; Failed proof retains the loan and all storage Latched error stays error despite later completion Unknown profile: no RTC / DMA / LPTIM MMIO Recover keeps masks; never another WFI Owned-reset retry only after DMA final-access proof; Observed external DMA or LPTIM reset during a loan Permanent quarantine; storage remains borrowed Quiet reset defaults do not prove a join; Compound exit: all four proofs are required; start succeeds; start fails with effects; ACCEPTED; start producer / masked WFI; finite DMA observed earlier service stays BUSY; success proof retained; cancel / deadline / error storage stays borrowed; accepted setup fails; producer withdrawn and acknowledged; DMA final access proved; peripheral and IRQ proof; final SETTLED only; public stop retry; ledger stays owned; access profile lost; missing write-OK: first keep producer + loan; any compound proof fails; valid profile; recover carry failure before withdrawal; external reset observed at any active-loan phase
